name: Dynamic Cable & Security LLC
old_description: Security cameras, Audio Systems, Fiber Splicing Services, TV and Audio Custom Installation, and Custom Display systems.
about:
Based in Yankton, South Dakota, Dynamic Cable & Security LLC draws on more than two decades of field experience in low-voltage systems. The company was founded by a technician who spent 20 years working on fiber optic construction, CCTV, security cameras, audio and video systems, and low-voltage wiring across the Kansas City metro area before returning to Yankton to serve the region.

The firm provides full-service low-voltage solutions, including security camera system design, installation, and maintenance for analog and IP networks; fiber optic splicing, testing, termination, and emergency repair for both aerial and underground plant; whole-home and commercial audio/video design and installation, from home theaters to multi-zone distributed systems and custom display walls; and mobile solar-powered CCTV trailers equipped with 8MP PTZ cameras and license-plate recognition, available for sale or rent. The team reports more than 500 completed jobs and offers 24/7 on-call support across a 250-mile radius covering South Dakota, Nebraska, and Iowa.

Customers range from single-family homes and apartment complexes to farms, commercial businesses, colleges, public schools, and government facilities. The company’s fiber optic services also support telecommunications carriers needing outage response and routine terminations.

Dynamic Cable & Security emphasizes a "big city solutions with a small town feel" approach, backing its security camera installations with a minimum five-year warranty and highlighting its ability to handle everything from routine terminations to complex fiber restoration using specialized tools and hands-on expertise.
